**Finding submitted: missing (LOL-CAP, critical).**

The agreement is entirely silent on liability. Confirmed across the full document:
- No hits for "damages", "consequential", "liable", "indemnif", "in no event", or any cap language.
- The only "liability" references are the no-joint-venture disclaimers (§10.2), and the only "aggregate" reference is the Termination Payment formula (§4.2).
- Warranties (§9) covers authority reps and the Globix carve-out only; General Provisions (§10) has no liability terms.

Both parties are exposed to unlimited liability, so even the fallback (mutual 12-month cap with indemnity/confidentiality/gross-negligence carve-outs) is unmet.

**Redline (validated ok:true):** new §9(c) inserting the preferred mutual cap — greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable by the Company and USD 1,000,000 — plus a mutual consequential-damages waiver, uncapped Excluded Claims (confidentiality/data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement), and confirmation that the Company's payment obligations (including the Termination Payment) are not capped damages. Placing it in §9 means it survives under the existing §10.7 survival list, and the comment offers a straight 12-months'-fees cap as the fallback.
